name: Kami War
description: The war between kami and humans on Kamigawa.

description_citations.text: "Toshiro Umezawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi, in Michiko's employ and beholden to the Myojin of Night's Reach, tries to honor his commitments as the Kami War threatens Kamigawa and a spirit beast threatens the world.
timeline.quote: But as the Kami War threatens to engulf Kamigawa , an unimaginably powerful spirit beast threatens the world.

citation.text: "Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lord Takeshi Konda steals O-Kagachi's heart in 3207 AR, enraging it and starting the Kami War.
timeline.quote: Lord Takeshi Konda stole the great kami's "heart" and a portion of its power

citation.text: "God", section "O-Kagachi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Order of Jukai was established about 1,200 years after the Kami War.
timeline.quote: the Order of Jukai was established to preserve nature and reverence for the spirits.

citation.text: "Jukai", section "The Order of Jukai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The theft of O-Kagachi's scion starts the Kami War.
timeline.quote: It was because the theft of O-Kagachi's scion, that the Kami War began.

citation.text: "Kami", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Damage from the Apocalypse Chime weakens the veil, letting Konda pull an aspect of O-Kagachi through it and begin the Kami War.

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Enraged, O-Kagachi moves the other kami to strike the mortal world, beginning the Kami War.

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko and Kyodai assume O-Kagachi's role as guardian of the veil; the war ends.
timeline.quote: The war ended soon after the Serpent's defeat

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "The Battle for the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With the Kami War the o-bakemono free many oni masters hoping to destroy Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: the o-bakemono succeeded in freeing many of their oni masters from their spiritual prisons

citation.text: "Ogre", section "Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As the Kami War begins, the five kirin meet in a teahouse inside a painting in Minamo; Pipe argues for non-interference.

citation.text: "Pipe", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Kami War the orochi refuse to take up arms against the nature spirits and let themselves be slaughtered.
timeline.quote: At first, they refused to take up arms against the nature spirits they worshipped, letting themselves be slaughtered instead.

citation.text: "Snake", section "Orochi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
